video_title: Cason Wallace Talks Coach Cal, Kentucky & Playing 1-on-1 vs. Girlfriend Kiki Rice

quotes.speaker: Cason Wallace
quotes.summary_phrase: Cason Wallace on his recruitment to Kentucky and the program's culture
quotes.excerpt: My number one choice was Kentucky. They were living like rock stars.
quotes.quote: I came straight out of high school. I was going to Kentucky if I didn't go straight from high school to the pros. That's where I was going. My number one choice was Kentucky. This is 1997, 1996-97. They were living like rock stars. I'm talking about the way the player lounge was, what they were driving. I said, damn. The building, it's upgraded now, but back then, they were living like some real high-level basketball players and that's where I wanted to be. And then you don't have to go outside in the cold to get to practice. I was like, yeah. That's why his whole fandom of Kentucky.

quotes.speaker: Cason Wallace
quotes.summary_phrase: Cason Wallace on Coach Calipari's ability to develop players for the NBA
quotes.excerpt: He's one of the best at building players up in my opinion.
quotes.quote: He's one of the best at building players up in my opinion. He knows your game to a T pretty much. He limits you to what you do best at first and once you're very dominant at that, then he lets you. Now he's like, okay, you get it now and he gives you a lot more, then he lets you grow. But I feel like a lot of times, we all go into college and some might not know. Going to college and it's like you feel like you have everything and then there's some things that isn't as polished and he's like, don't even worry about that right now. Focus on what you're very good at. That's what's going to get you to the next level.

quotes.speaker: Cason Wallace
quotes.summary_phrase: Cason Wallace on Coach Calipari's support for players with family struggles
quotes.excerpt: He does a great job of helping those guys get to the NBA that are having family struggles.
quotes.quote: What I love about Cal, Cal does a great job of going to get those players, they're dogs. He knows they're dogs. But also the family dynamic is not structured properly and he does a great job of helping those guys get to the NBA that are having family struggles from an economical standpoint. Cal is really good at that and that's what I appreciate about him. Like, hey, if you are a top 10, top 15 draft pick, you ain't staying in college, man. Go take care of your family, bro. Get up out of here, go take care of your family. So that's why I respect Cal.

quotes.speaker: Cason Wallace
quotes.summary_phrase: Cason Wallace on Kiki Rice's historic draft selection
quotes.excerpt: She gets drafted to the Tempo and I'm telling her the whole day, you don't even understand.
quotes.quote: Her class is my class really. I've known all of them from McDonald's and just growing up. So I kind of lived the college life through them a little bit, honestly. But just seeing them and her, you know, just accomplish their goals. They've been saying they want to make it to the final four and they got there junior year. And then senior year they're like, we're all seniors, let's just do it. And then a few months later, she gets drafted to the Tempo and I'm telling her the whole day, like, you don't even understand, you're literally in the history books right now for college and then two months later in the NBA. You're the first like Tempo draft pick. You're like, it's it's crazy.

quotes.speaker: Cason Wallace
quotes.summary_phrase: Cason Wallace on playing 1-on-1 against Kiki Rice
quotes.excerpt: The first time we worked out, she called me out to play ones.
quotes.quote: The first time we worked out, she called me out to play ones. I'm like, what? Are you serious right now? And then I had to tell her like, you're nice and I can't take it easy on you. Just let you know that off rip. Before we even get started, this ain't what you want. I have to play you serious because you could be me. You could actually be me. So she actually like she almost won a few spots. She ain't win. Hey, easy. She was close to winning. So she was close to winning.
